data.summary: Committing the job moved it from jobs/pending/ (gitignored: 'pending/*.job.json') to jobs/examples/, which the repo's own .gitignore says is where curated jobs belong. ob-outcome was pinned to the old path, so its pin no longer resolves and the judge will refuse it. A registered job that cannot be committed would rot exactly as the runner did, so the move is right and the pin has to follow: re-accept ob-outcome against the examples/ path before judging.
